modification.description: Add styling for staff-only posts message
modification.replace: Staff-Only Reply

modification.description: Add staff-only checkbox to reply form
modification.replace:
<div class="formButtonGroup-primary">
        <xf:if is="!$simpleSubmit && $nodeId && $xf.visitor.hasNodePermission($nodeId, 'staffReplies')">
            <label style="cursor: pointer; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; margin-right: 10px;">
                <input type="checkbox" name="staff_only" id="staffOnlyCheckbox" value="1" 
                    style="
                        width: 20px; 
                        height: 20px; 
                        border: 2px solid #aaa; 
                        border-radius: 4px; 
                        background-color: white; 
                        cursor: pointer; 
                        display: inline-block; 
                        margin-right: 3px; 
                        margin-bottom: 5px;
                        position: relative; 
                        transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; 
                        vertical-align: middle;
                    "
                    onchange="this.style.backgroundColor = this.checked ? '#888' : 'white'; 
                             this.style.borderColor = this.checked ? '#666' : '#aaa';"
                />
                Staff-Only
            </label>
        </xf:if>

modification.description: Add node id for the staff-only checkbox permission check
